_comment: Description demand fits the budget; demand plus the name floor does not. A 5,000-token window at 0.01 and 4 bytes per token budgets 200 characters. Four competing skills with 3-character names and 50-character descriptions demand exactly 200, which the old demand-only verdict called listing-fits. The product renders each as `- <name>: <description>` (name + 4 + 50 = 57) joined by newlines, so the listing is 4 x 57 + 3 = 231 characters and overflows by 31. The floor is 4 x (3 + 2) + 3 = 23, leaving 177 for grants of 50 + 2 each: three fit (156), the lowest-scored one (p:d) is shed.
